description: Build a fresh Solana mainnet v0 transaction and quote for a Limitless bonding-curve buy/sell. Every signature is zero. The caller must independently validate, simulate, sign and broadcast. No keys accepted. Network fees and possible account/escrow rent are extra.

amount.description: Exact base units as a string: buy uses lamports, sell uses token base units. No decimals or exponent notation.

mint.description: Solana token mint; only existing Limitless bonding curves.

name: build_unsigned_trade
